About Us

Kittu's Cloud Kitchen serves freshly prepared vegetarian homestyle meals in West Delhi, with ordering and confirmation through WhatsApp.

Privacy

Customer name, phone number, delivery address and optional location are used only to prepare, confirm and deliver the order. Location is accessed only after browser permission.

Refund & Cancellation

Please contact Kittu's Cloud Kitchen on WhatsApp as soon as possible for cancellation or payment issues. Orders already under preparation may not be cancellable. Approved refunds, where applicable, are processed subject to the payment provider or bank's processing time.

Terms & Conditions

Menu availability, sabji of the day and delivery estimates may vary based on ingredients, demand, traffic and delivery location. Free delivery is available on orders of ₹499 or above. Orders below ₹499 have a ₹25 delivery charge. The final payable amount shown at checkout includes the applicable delivery charge.
